title: baseVultra: Compact Nonlinear Recurrence with Reallocated Capacity
abstract: arXiv:2610.30154v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Nonlinear recurrent networks remain useful for streaming sequence modeling, yet gated cell design is still dominated by LSTM and GRU. We study whether recurrent computation can be reallocated away from gate transforms and toward candidate generation. We propose baseVultra, a compact recurrent cell that concentrates the dense recurrent budget on a single H x H candidate-generation matrix, while replacing recurrent gate matrices with O(H) diagonal interactions. translated_title: baseVultra：具有容量重新分配的紧凑非线性递归网络
translated_abstract: 非线性递归网络在流式序列建模中仍然很有用，然而门控单元的设计仍然由LSTM和GRU主导。我们研究递归计算是否可以从门控变换重新分配到候选生成上。我们提出了baseVultra，这是一种紧凑的递归单元，它将密集的递归计算预算集中在单个H x H的候选生成矩阵上，同时用O(H)的对角交互替换递归门控矩阵。候选更新将这个密集分支与两个低秩辅助分支、一个EMA缓存以及可学习的输出混合相结合；门控还通过对角项获得对h_{t-2}的轻量级二阶访问。在TinyShakespeare字符级语言建模任务上，baseVultra在紧凑的单层200K参数设置中实现了1.594的验证损失，而参数量匹配的LSTM为1.604，参数量匹配的GRU为1.616。
tldr: 提出baseVultra紧凑递归单元，将递归计算从门控变换重新分配到候选生成，在参数量匹配条件下于TinyShakespeare字符级语言建模上超越LSTM和GRU。
en_tdlr: baseVultra is a compact recurrent cell that reallocates recurrent computation from gate transforms to candidate generation, outperforming parameter-matched LSTM and GRU on TinyShakespeare character-level language modeling.
